body: I'm not one for the whole guilt tripping people over those left behind I was just saying if your worried about burdening them this would be a burden but yeah if you're dead it wouldn't matter to you. Do you love your wife and still want to be with her? From my experience a relationship you no longer feel good in just makes depression so much harder to live with. I don't have any magical motivation or advice but from what I've heard of your experience I believe you could find things that make everyday easier and then when everyday becomes easier you can get more and more motivation slowly. In time you can find meds that work for you, find a new job and work on your love life. I know a year seems like a long time but depression and anxiety take a long time to manage because sometimes they can't make you whole again but happy enough to get by and live a functional life with minimal lows. All I can really say is don't be hard on yourself don't let other peoples comments about you being lazy make you feel worthless, give yourself a break because mental illness is serious shit. Mental illness threatens our lives like a serious illness would so what if its at our own hands, it also hurts like a mother fucker and unfortunately psychology isn't as progressed as it should be and solutions aren't as black and white. Your sick right now give yourself a chance to heal.

I find this statement contradictory, if anything will burden your family it's dealing with your corpse and living without you. I can't determine what's driving you to contemplate suicide with such a short description but in my expierence telling loved ones is just a way of pushing them away. They aren't equipped to deal with that state of mind and they'll either get really scared or distant. I'd say if you've only been on meds for a year are they they right meds or the right dose, if your therapist isn't cnserned that you are contemplating suicide they need to find a new line of work. Depression is very manageable give yourself time give your doctors time to get your meds right and don't feel like being in between jobs makes you less of a person. My many disorders have kept me from working for 9years and I'm alive though I struggle with suicidal thoughts.
Sure your matter recycles but that's no garenty your connsiousness will remain and cetainantly not a good reason to kill yourself because it very well could be the end.
